titulo: Essential irregular verbs: Venir, decir, dar, ver and saber

aula.objetivo: Use the most frequent irregular verbs in the present: ir, hacer, poner, salir, venir, decir, dar, ver and saber, and tell «ver» apart from «mirar», «decir» from «hablar», and «saber» + infinitive.

sessao.titulo: Venir, decir, dar, ver and saber

blocos.titulo: Five verbs you use every day
blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: «venir» (to come) does two things at once: in «yo» it gains a «g» (vengo), and in tú, él and ellos, the stem's «e» becomes «ie»: vengo, vienes, viene, venimos, venís, vienen. The «e → ie» pattern gets a full, calm explanation in lesson 13. STEP 2: «decir» (to say) has «yo digo» and changes «e → i» in the stressed forms: digo, dices, dice, decimos, decís, dicen. STEP 3: «dar» (to give) is regular except in «yo»: doy, das, da, damos, dais, dan. Notice the «-oy» ending, just like «voy» and «estoy». STEP 4: «ver» (to see): veo, ves, ve, vemos, veis, ven. Only «yo» is irregular, and none of the other forms carry an accent mark. STEP 5: «saber» (to know): sé, sabes, sabe, sabemos, sabéis, saben. «Sé» carries an accent mark so it isn't confused with the pronoun «se» (as in «Se llama Ana»). STEP 6: «saber» + infinitive means «to know how to do something» (a learned skill): «Sé cocinar», «No sé nadar». With a fact, it just means «to know»: «Sé que vives en Sevilla». STEP 7: to lock these in, memorize the «yo» form of these verbs as one list: voy, hago, pongo, salgo, vengo, digo, doy, veo, sé — plus «tengo» and «estoy», which you already know. STEP 8: pronunciation: «vengo» sounds like BEN-go, with a hard «g»; «digo» sounds like DEE-go; «veo» has two separate vowels (beh-O).
blocos.comparacao: English «I come, I say, I give, I see, I know» are all irregular too, so the pattern of irregularity itself isn't surprising — it's just a different set of irregular forms to learn: vengo, digo, doy, veo, sé. The one real trap is the accent mark on «sé», which keeps it apart from the unrelated pronoun «se».

exemplos.pt: Are you coming to my house on Saturday?

exemplos.ru: Doy un regalo a mi hermana.
exemplos.pt: I'm giving my sister a gift.
I can't see well without glasses.
I know how to cook paella.

erros.motivo: «Sé» (from saber) carries an accent mark; «se» with no accent is a different word.

blocos.enunciado: Say six sentences, one with each verb: «Vengo de… Digo que… Doy… Veo… Sé…» Use true facts about yourself, for example «Sé cocinar», «Veo series por la noche».
Conjugate «ir» from memory and say one sentence with «hago», one with «pongo», and one with «salgo».
